content.title: THE REAL REASON YOUR {{BLOATING}} WON'T GO AWAY
facts: **Peppermint tea** – relaxes the gut muscles and eases trapped gas within 20-30 minutes.
**Papaya** – contains papain, an enzyme that breaks down protein so your stomach doesn't have to work overtime.
**Bananas** – 1 ripe banana/day helps flush excess sodium that causes water retention and puffiness.
**Caraway seeds** – chew ½ tsp after meals to calm cramping and speed up digestion.
**Tart cherry juice** – 1 small glass before bed reduces the inflammation behind morning stiffness.
**Oats** – 1 bowl/day softens stool and takes pressure off a sluggish, backed-up gut.
**Celery** – its natural water content and sodium balance quietly deflate afternoon bloat.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Bloating usually isn't random — it's your gut asking for help in a language most people never learned to read. Peppermint tea works by relaxing the smooth muscle lining your intestines, which lets trapped gas move through instead of sitting there building pressure. Papaya is a bit of a secret weapon too: the papain enzyme it carries starts breaking down protein before it even hits your stomach acid, so less heavy food sits around fermenting. And caraway seeds have been used for centuries specifically because the oils in them calm intestinal spasms almost on contact — that's why a pinch after a heavy meal can stop cramping before it starts. Everyone's gut reacts a little differently, so pay attention to what actually settles yours.
